description: This file defines the interface JsonField, which models a JSON field as a key-value pair with additional meta-information, including factory methods for creation, accessors for key, value, and definition, and methods to check markers and serialize the data.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new JsonField with specified key and value, optionally including a definition.

methods.name: isValueNonNull
methods.description: Returns a predicate to test if the JSON field's value is not null.

methods.name: getKeyName
methods.description: Returns the key name of this JSON field.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the JsonKey object representing this JSON field's key.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the JsonValue object representing this JSON field's value.

methods.name: getDefinition
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the JsonFieldDefinition for this field, if present.

methods.name: isMarkedAs
methods.description: Checks if this field has at least all specified markers.

methods.name: writeKeyAndValue
methods.description: Serializes the key and value of this JSON field into the given context.
